text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Pheeew, played a ton today! I'll get you 
cleaned up in no time!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry, Carrotman! I just wanted to clean 
you fast, and ended up using too much 
force...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...Ugh... How pathetic of me, as a 
hero..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
His cherished mask had broken, leaving 
Biko Pegasus feeling down...
